advice.text: No loopback signal on In 2. Check the Out 2 → In 2 cable, and that In 2 gain is not fully off.

The loopback is not linear: its gain changes by 3.4 dB over 20 dB of level, so In 2 is clipping. Turn In 2 gain fully down and use a TRS line cable; if it persists, lower loop_send_db in configs/rig.json.
